2025-09-01.riddle: I can break without being touched, I vanish if you speak my name. What am I?

2025-09-02.riddle: I have roots but never grow, rings but no fingers. My history is written in circles. What am I?
2025-09-02.hint: Count my rings to see my age.

2025-09-03.riddle: The more of me you share, the less of me you keep. What am I?
2025-09-03.hint: Once spoken, I’m no longer yours.

2025-09-04.riddle: I have a neck but no head, I hold water but never drink. What am I?
2025-09-04.hint: You can fill me, but I never sip.

2025-09-05.riddle: I travel the world but stay in one corner. What am I?

2025-09-06.riddle: I build bridges from thought to thought, yet I weigh nothing. What am I?
2025-09-06.hint: I connect minds without being seen.

2025-09-07.riddle: I’m not alive, yet I grow. I need air but no lungs, and food but no mouth. What am I?
2025-09-07.hint: Feed me fuel or I fade away.

2025-09-08.riddle: I can capture moments without a brush or pen. I freeze time with a single click. What am I?
